svg.title: F16-1 Double-conversion UPS B2-DH3-UPS-A1 with static bypass and external maintenance bypass
svg.text: Block LV switchboard, 415 V, from 2.5 MVA block transformer (3,478 A)
UPS output switchboard, 415 V, to busways and STS
F16-1 Double-conversion UPS B2-DH3-UPS-A1 with static bypass and external maintenance bypass
2,500 kW, 415 V, VFI-SS-111 · Q1 rectifier input, Q2 static bypass input, Q3 maintenance bypass, Q4 UPS output, QB battery breaker · 5 min autonomy, 301.4 kWh screen · normal load 62.5 %
• Transfer to maintenance bypass runs UPS to static bypass, close Q3, open Q4, with no RMS value below 90 % for more than one half cycle at the output switchboard.
• The Q3 interlock must block closing while the inverter is not synchronised to the bypass source; the test uses the manufacturer test mode.
